newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO invites Russia's Lebed to visit Brussels.
newsitem.headline: NATO invites Russia's Lebed to visit Brussels.

text.p: NATO has invited Russian security chief Alexander Lebed to visit its headquarters in Brussels on October 7 to discuss NATO enlargement and other issues, a spokesman for the alliance said on Saturday.
"We have received some indications through diplomatic channels that there is a good possibility General Lebed will come," he told Reuters.
The invitation to Lebed to visit the headquarters of the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation was in line with NATO's policy of holding regular dialogue with Russian leaders, the spokesman said.
He said NATO officials would like to discuss the alliance's planned eastwards expansion to take in some members of central and eastern Europe -- an issue that has caused tension with Moscow.
"It's just as important to make it clear to him (Lebed) that we want a special relationship with Russia," he said.
He said Lebed was now a "key figure" in Russia as secretary of its Security Council and had spoken extensively about NATO.
Lebed last month signed a peace deal with rebels in Chechnya to end fighting that began when Russian troops entered the region in December 1994 to crush its bid for independence.
